newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU, Czechs strike veterinary deal.
newsitem.headline: EU, Czechs strike veterinary deal.

text.p: The European Commission said on Friday it had concluded a draft agreement with the Czech republic on the mutual recognition of veterinary and plant health and animal welfare standards.
The accord still has to be approved by the 15 EU countries.
Under the agreement, the Czech republic will gradually bring its rules into line with those of the EU in preparation for its membership of 15 nation bloc.
"The draft agreement has the double aim of boosting trade and creating a climate of mutual confidence," the Commission said in a statement.

In December the EU signed a similar agreement with New Zealand. In March it reached agreement in principle with Canada and on April 30 a deal with the United States on red meat, dairy and fish products.
